# Project Design Context

## Project

- Name: github-founder-certificate-generator
- Product type: Responsive event certificate generator
- Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Canvas
- Color mode: dark
- Density: focused

## Sources

- Tokens and typography: `dist/index.html` CSS variables and font declarations
- Components: native HTML forms, Canvas certificate, accessible dialog
- Assets: `dist/blank-reference.png`, `dist/mobile-scene.png`

## Design

- Palette: near-black `#080706`, warm black `#0b0908`, gold `#edc584`, cream `#fff0d0`, warm ivory certificate artwork.
- UI type: DM Sans with Arial fallback. Display type: Cormorant Garamond. Kicker type: Cinzel.
- Motion: slow ambient glow, stars, and occasional meteors; brief control feedback and a short generated-certificate reveal. All motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve the existing black, gold, and ivory visual identity and supplied certificate artwork.
- Preserve participant-name placement and existing PNG/PDF workflows.
- Keep the no-build static deployment, responsive layout, and mobile usability.
- Respect reduced-motion preferences.

### Avoid

- Avoid new frameworks/runtime dependencies, long animations, and changes to certificate artwork or content.

## Decision

- Keep the existing premium layout and add concise tactile feedback plus a brief certificate reveal to make the interface feel more responsive. Implemented 2026-10-09.
